routeHint: Select the route shown in this chart. The list contains the route planning and selected routes on the map.
chartModeHintDefault: Uses the shared default settings — changes apply to every chart without its own custom settings.
chartModeHintCustom: Has its own custom settings — changes only affect this chart.
showHeadingHint: Show the chart's heading above the chart. Tapping the heading opens the menu to switch between charts.
showStatsHint: Show the route statistics row above the chart.
ratioHint: Locks the chart's aspect ratio: the value is how much distance fits on one y-axis unit. Zooming and panning keep the ratio fixed. "Reset" restores the natural fit.
followMapHint: The chart stays in sync with the map: it shows exactly the route segment visible on the map. Panning the map updates the chart, and a "Fly to route" button appears when the map is panned away from the route. Any gesture on the chart switches this off.
removeChartHint: Removes this chart from the bottom drawer. The route stays on the map and nothing is deleted.
removeChartConfirmBody: Only the chart is removed from the bottom drawer. The route stays on the map, nothing is deleted, and the chart can be toggled on again at any time.
primaryDataHint: The main data series shown in the chart: elevation or slope. The left y-axis and the blue center values display this series.
primaryColorHint: How the primary series is colored: its own axis color, or a color ramp based on elevation or slope values. The "fill" options additionally color the area between the line and the x-axis.
secondaryDataHint: An optional second data series with its own right y-axis. Select "None" to hide it.
secondaryColorHint: How the secondary series is colored: its own axis color, or a color ramp based on elevation or slope values. The "fill" options additionally color the area between the line and the x-axis.
